rules.statement: An isolated transaction can be an adventure in the nature of trade within the meaning of section 6(1)(a) of the Income Tax Ordinance, provided there are appropriate circumstances.
rules.supporting_quote: "This is an appeal from a judgment of the Supreme Court of Ceylon dated 29th May, 1956, dismissing an appeal on a Case Stated by the Board of Review under section 74 of the Income Tax Ordinance (C. 188)."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 6 (1) (a) of the Income Tax Ordinance
